Copy the selected release into the HeavyMap Pages build artifact at a versioned, same-origin path

— Range / CORS: PMTiles requires HTTP byte ranges. Protomaps documents GitHub Pages as a PMTiles host. Same-origin avoids cross-origin permission checks. A live response check is still required. · Size and access: The candidate is about 222 MiB against GitHub Pages' 1 GiB published-site limit. It can be copied at build time without adding data rows or a binary archive to HeavyMap source history. The build would need authorized read access to the private data repo. · Finding: Best fit for D-036's existing direction to keep the data repo as source and pull the selected release into the HeavyMap Pages site, if the pre-launch smoke test passes.
Publish a separate Pages site from

— Range / CORS: A separate origin requires CORS as well as range support. Protomaps says GitHub Pages can host PMTiles, but this candidate's cross-origin responses are not yet verified. · Size and access: The repository is public by owner approval for this preview. Pages would add a separate origin and CORS boundary. · Finding: No advantage demonstrated for v1; adds a CORS and publication boundary.
Fetch GitHub Release assets directly from HeavyMap

— Range / CORS: Cross-origin redirect/range behavior and browser-readable CORS headers have not been measured for this private repo. · Size and access: A browser viewer cannot use a private asset without credentials. Making the repository or asset public is a release action, gated by Stage A/B. · Finding: Not a viable current path; do not encode an asset URL.
Put the release in HeavyMap source or publish a separate object-storage host

— Range / CORS: Object storage can support byte ranges, but cross-origin delivery also requires configured CORS. · Size and access: Adds data to the product repository or introduces a new service, credentials, configuration and cost surface without a demonstrated need at this size. · Finding: Not selected for this candidate. Revisit if site payload/bandwidth limits or deployment tests fail.
